title: SigLIP 2: Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders with Improved Semantic Understanding, Localization, and Dense Features

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring 'representation bias' by evaluating the model's tendency to incorrectly associate random, neutral objects (such as cars) with a particular gender group.
Calculating performance disparity by measuring the maximum difference in zero-shot image classification accuracy on the Dollar Street dataset when disaggregated by household income level.
Evaluating zero-shot classification and geolocalization accuracy on geographically diverse datasets (GeoDE, GLDv2) and comparing performance across different geographic regions.
